title: Smoked Picanha Steak Platter
seoTitle: Smoked Picanha Steak Platter | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Show-stopping fat cap with smoker depth and a bright sauce
subtitle: Fat-cap Brazilian cut, coarse salt, and chimichurri for ten
description: Adapted from classic Brazilian picanha tradition (Traeger, Hey Grill Hey): picanha roasts get coarse salt, smoke at 275°F to 125°F, sear fat-side down, and slice with chimichurri for a crew platter.

steps.title: Prep picanha
steps.instruction: Score fat cap in crosshatch without cutting into meat. Coat fat cap heavily with coarse salt and pepper. Let sit 20 minutes.

steps.title: Smoke at 275°F
steps.instruction: Smoke picanha fat-side up at 275°F until internal temp reaches 120–125°F, about 35–45 minutes.

steps.title: Build chimichurri
steps.instruction: Pulse parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, oil, and pepper flakes until chunky. Rest at room temp.

steps.title: Sear fat cap
steps.instruction: Sear fat-side down over direct heat at 500°F+ 4–5 minutes until fat crisps and internal hits 130°F medium-rare.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes. Slice against the grain into 1/4-inch slices, keeping fat cap on each slice.

steps.title: Hold at 170°F
steps.instruction: Arrange slices on a platter, cover loosely with foil, hold at 170°F. Serve chimichurri cold on the side.

steps.title: Tonight's board
steps.instruction: Picanha platter with chimichurri, grilled limes, and farro or rice if you want starch.

steps.title: Leftovers
steps.instruction: Slice thin for steak sandwiches with chimichurri. Reheat gently at 325°F until 145°F.

proTips: Salt the fat cap hard—it's the flavor engine on picanha.
Slice thin; thick slices chew tough even when temp is perfect.
Chimichurri on the side keeps bright flavor; don't cook it.
tonightSpread: Sliced picanha on a board with fat cap showing.
leftovers: Picanha bowls with rice and black beans.
Chimichurri steak wraps with pickled onion.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Picanha is the steak that looks expensive and cooks forgiving. Sliced with chimichurri, it holds at 170°F for 30 minutes without losing character.
mealPrepNotes: Score fat cap lightly before salt. Smoke whole, sear, rest 10 minutes, slice. Hold sliced beef covered at 170°F with chimichurri on the side.
